about.heading: About me
about.paragraph1: I am almost a Computer Technician, interested in technology since childhood. My curiosity took me from hardware repair to setting up my own personal homelab with Linux for hosting services with Docker.
about.paragraph2: In programming, I have carried out backend tasks mostly oriented to relational databases and their application in web systems.

gie.title: GIE — School Reports Management
gie.description: I collaborated in a development team to build GIE (Gestor de Informes Escolares), an application designed for the administration and tracking of student-related reports. The system manages the history and timeline of each report, records its progression, and controls the step-by-step escalation to the different responsible school authorities, facilitating full traceability and comprehensive follow-up of each case.

database.title: Database: Student Management
database.description: Relational system for school management (students, teachers, absences and behavior). Includes advanced queries, views, stored functions, cursors, triggers and privilege control by user role.

homelab.title: Home Homelab
homelab.description: Self-managed home server for service virtualization and application deployment in its own controlled environment, ensuring privacy and continuous experimentation.
